rationale: Several papers investigate potential resolutions to the Hubble tension, such as dynamical dark energy models, interacting radiation, late dark energy transitions, and early dark energy. These studies provide substantive new evidence on possible causes of the discrepancy, but the question remains unsettled. Key papers include 2101.02168, 2111.00014, 2002.11707, 2103.09729, and 2009.10733.
